title: French Baked Potatoes
description: A simple and comforting French-inspired dish featuring tender baked potatoes.

ingredients.name: Syrian
ingredients.notes: Assumes Syrian is a type of seasoning or spice blend

instructions: Scrub the potatoes clean and poke some holes in each with a fork.
Rub the potatoes with a little bit of Syrian seasoning.
Place the potatoes directly on the middle rack of the oven.
Bake for 45-60 minutes or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of Syrian seasoning if desired.
